dedupe_keys.name: urg forecast core reference pipeline for chilean emergency department analytics forecasting and simulation

description: urg-forecast-core is a Python package published by Nicolás Vera Zúñiga at Eunosia for emergency-department forecasting and simulation in Chile. It converts visits into hourly occupancy, adds Chilean calendar features, and provides a common quantile-forecasting interface for seasonal-naive, statsforecast and LightGBM methods. An empirical length-of-stay Monte Carlo simulator, pinball-loss evaluation tools, a DEIS MINSAL data client and a reference dashboard are included in the described release. The July 2026 Zenodo archive preserves version 0.1.0, with links to GitHub and PyPI. The MIT licence permits free reuse. Hospital coverage and historical input dates depend on the supplied records and are not fixed by the package metadata. A modeller could use its occupancy transformations to prepare demand inputs and compare capacity forecasts. Runtime performance remains unknown because no benchmark was rerun, and no technical integration with an existing catalogue record was verified.
